description: Wave-07 final residual fortify checked wrappers: syslog pair renders through fl's engine and drops silently on transport failure (void return, deterministic in the sandbox), and vfwprintf writes wide into an fl tmpfile stream with the multibyte read-back pinned. Raw buffer addresses never compared, FILE pointers limited to fl-owned streams closed before return, filesystem paths never touched, process ids never captured, wall-clock timing never captured.
spec_reference: GNU _FORTIFY_SOURCE object-size checked wrappers: __syslog_chk, __vsyslog_chk, __vfwprintf_chk complete the 53-member tranche (bd-reality-202609-lx578q.6.1).
